body:
## Features
- Added translucent white silhouettes for unit parts hidden behind hills and cliffs, without revealing cloaked units or units in fog.
- GDI foundation joints now use player colors while concrete panels stay neutral.
- Added public tournament brackets and optional administrator-started attendance timers.
- Tournament results are reported promptly while the post-game statistics screen stays available for three minutes.

## Bug Fixes
- Fixed crystals on lower ground appearing on top of nearby hills.
- Fixed refinery entrances and unloading bays that could block harvesters, including China's additional bays.
- Fixed missing black-flame colors in scorch effects.

Update clients and servers to v0.97.5 before playing together. Replay playback requires a compatible game version.
